ice_cream.prompt:
Create a production game sprite sheet of the SAME female ice-cream vendor in reference image 1, now drawn as a COMPLETE FULL-BODY character from cap to shoes in EVERY frame. Reference image 2 (pier diner) defines the game's approved detailed 32-bit sprite style and full-body proportions. Keep the woman's brown wavy bob, teal earrings, cream paper cap with teal stripe, teal shirt, coral neck scarf and cream apron. Add navy trousers, sensible dark teal shoes; apron reaches her knees. Clear adult face/hands, stepped navy outlines and compact sprite shading like the diner, not smooth painted art and not simple geometric shapes.
ONE transparent RGBA landscape sheet, EXACTLY four equal columns and two equal rows with EIGHT separate FULL-BODY poses. Each character is complete with both feet, ample transparent margins, same scale and aligned floor baseline across all cells. No text, gridlines, food, utensils, counter or scenery. Fixed three-quarter front view facing screen-right; feet planted in the same place, no walking; empty hands throughout.
Reading order: 0 neutral welcoming idle; 1 idle blink; 2 glance down hands inward to prepare; 3 hands preparing near waist; 4 slight forward lean serving arm extending down/forward toward an imaginary counter at waist height; 5 SETTING FOOD DOWN onto that imaginary counter, palm down fingers opening (not a hand-to-hand exchange); 6 empty hand withdrawing; 7 return to neutral idle. The forward placing action must be a visibly distinct arm pose but preserve head/body size and foot positions. Full-height master artwork will be displayed behind a booth mask in-game, so do NOT crop the body or include the booth. Genuinely transparent background, separate isolated sprites, high quality consistent character identity.

hotdog.prompt:
Create a second distinct seaside stall worker to accompany the woman in this reference image. Same detailed retro game sprite style and adult character scale. This new vendor is a cheerful adult woman with copper-red hair tied into a short ponytail, a coral-red baseball cap, coral-red short-sleeved shirt, cream apron, navy trousers and brown shoes. She works at the hot-dog stand. Change her face and hair so she is clearly a different person from the teal ice-cream worker.
Produce a matching full-body sprite sheet: four equal columns, two equal rows, eight complete cap-to-shoe figures, ample transparent gutters and a consistent foot baseline. Genuinely transparent background. Fixed three-quarter view facing right, feet planted and all hands empty. Poses in order: idle; blink; looks down to prepare; hands working at waist; forward lean and reach down; sets food on an imaginary counter with open palm down; withdraws empty hand; recovers to idle. No food, booth, counter, text, gridlines or background objects. Every frame must retain the full body and both shoes.
